---
name: Question or idea
about: Ask a question, propose an idea, or describe something that is unclear
title: "[Question/Idea] "
---

## What are you trying to understand or improve?

Describe the question, problem, or idea in your own words.

## What do you currently understand?

It is completely acceptable to be uncertain. Tell us what you think the project means so far.

## What is unclear or missing?

If documentation confused you, please say where. Newcomer confusion is useful project feedback.

## Possible direction (optional)

You do not need to have a solution before opening this issue.

## Community impact (optional)

Could resolving this make IDKMesh easier to discover, understand, join, or contribute to?
